text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any fund in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated
so much as may be necessary to implement Article XII-A, Section 2, of the Constitution up to the end of the
current fiscal year. Thereafter, the necessary appropriations therefor shall be included in the annual General
Appropriations Decree.

The payment of the salaries as provided for under Article XII-A, Section 2, of the Constitution
shall be effective from assumption of office.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
